items.difficulty_reason: The non-routine formula-preserving reduction replaces circuit-only Newton inversion with PropertyS/Jacobian linearization and homogeneous-component extraction,then applies it to separated Jacobi–Trudi entries to transfer determinant hardness to nonmultilinear Schur families.
